g.text: Digital Credential Issuance part 1 : request until offer link (SD-JWT VC, HSM-backed Issuer, On-Device Credential Model)
Mobile App (Core ทางรัฐ)
Mobile App (Core ทางรัฐ)
Private key is generated inside HSM
Engine stores key metadata and HSM reference
VCVP Core receives ISSUER_KEY_ID and publicKey only
[IN DEVELOPMENT] engine v1.86.1 key storage supports only INTERNAL , AZURE_VAULT , SIGN8
SECURE_ELEMENT , REMOTE_SECURE_ELEMENT , no HSM , PKCS11 removed since v1.78.2
Login with Tang Rat to get Token
Login completed , show Tang Rat home
[SPEC] A card/document is added to the wallet only when both conditions hold
1. applicant data is linked from the government source of truth (section 2)
2. the VC is issued and verified by the wallet (sections 8 , 9)
Any problem in VC issuance returns an error to the wallet , the wallet stops
No card/document is added without a VC
Check holder key exists on this device
Check holder key exists on this device
(key alias in Android Keystore / Secure Enclave)
[Holder key not found on device (first use of Document Wallet on this device)]
Create and register the holder key
Request holder key registration challenge + Token | POST /dw/v1/holder-keys/challenge (DW endpoint 01)
[DATA STORE] Store challenge in DW database
Generate holder key pair (Secure Enclave / Android Keystore / StrongBox)
Sign challenge with holder private key
Submit holder proof + Token | POST /dw/v1/holder-keys/register (DW endpoint 02)
[DATA STORE] Store holder public key , device status = HOLDER_BOUND
[SPEC] Key found on the device does not confirm it is registered in DW
DW checks registration by deviceId below
[PENDING] For team discussion : the wallet does not send identity assurance to DW today
How the wallet logs in and obtains the IdP ID token is part of the wallet, the wallet
team must decide where the code is exchanged
Request to add card / document + Token (from Tang Rat login) | POST /v1/virtualcards/sync_queue_list (DW endpoint 03) (deviceId registered with the holder key)
[DATA STORE] Store issuance request in DW database
Look up holder key of this device in DW database
(look up by deviceId , device status = HOLDER_BOUND)
[Holder key of this device not registered]
Response of 1.2 tells the app to register the holder key again (same steps as 1.2)
so the next request can receive the card/document with a VC
no response yet , the error is returned in section 2.1
[PENDING] Load IdP signing keys (IdP jwks_uri , cached)
signature (IdP JWKS , ES256) , iss = IdP , aud = client_id registered with the IdP , exp , nonce
Check pid in ID token = CitizenId from Token
[ERROR AUDIT] Store DW audit log (FailureReason = IDENTITY_ASSURANCE_INVALID)
Cannot proceed , please log in again
auth_time stored as last authentication timestamp
amr stored as last authentication method (if provided)
issued ID token reference (jti) stored in audit
[DATA STORE] Store identity assurance profile in DW database
Use identity assurance profile stored at last login
[SPEC] Identity assurance profile in DW database
Check VC possible for this request (mark set in 1.2)
(the request already failed in 1.2 , it ends with an error in section 2.1)
[PENDING] RequiredLoA is set by the issuing agency on the schema
Not taken from the Trust Registry , its LoA support is not known yet
[PENDING] Get RequiredLoA of the requested document from DW catalog
still valid (assurance expiry) , meets required freshness ,
[Assurance invalid / expired / not fresh / IAL below RequiredLoA]
(VC not issued , this request ends here)
Response of 1.2 : request step-up verification or re-KYC | reason , RequiredLoA
Show message : identity verification is not enough for this card/document (reason , RequiredLoA)
ask the user to verify identity again in Tang Rat before continuing
Submit verification result (new IdP ID token) | POST /dw/v1/identity-assurance/step-up (DW endpoint 04)
Verify new ID token (same checks as above)
[DATA STORE] Store updated identity assurance profile in DW database
[ERROR AUDIT] Store DW audit log (FailureReason = LOA_INSUFFICIENT)
Send request 1.2 again for the same card/document
(the new request runs from section 1.2 with the updated identity assurance)
This request stops here , sections 2 to 11 do not apply to it
Look up applicant data in DW database
[ERROR AUDIT] Store DW audit log (FailureReason = AGENCY_DATA_NOT_FOUND / AGENCY_NOT_AUTHORIZED)
sourceSystem = Government API Source of Truth
cachePolicy = reuse data in DW database if it already exists
[DATA STORE] Store applicant data + SyncDate in DW database
Use applicant data from DW database
Validate official data & Check status active & Check not suspended &
[ERROR AUDIT] Store DW audit log (FailureReason = SOURCE_DATA_INVALID)
2.1 Check VC is possible before issuing
Check VC possible for this request (mark set in 1.2)
[ERROR AUDIT] Store DW audit log (FailureReason = WALLET_NOT_ACTIVATED)
Register the holder key again (same steps as 1.2)
so the user can request the card/document again
Issuance stops here , card/document not added , sections 3 to 11 do not apply
3. Get Schema Details (VCVP Core checks the Trust Framework before issuance)
[SPEC] Get schema details and request issuance are used by two callers :
DW Core (this flow) and agency systems that call VCVP Core directly (system to system issuance)
Steps marked "caller channel = WALLET" run only for requests from DW Core
DW Core returns the error to the app , VCVP Core only returns the reason
[SPEC] VCVP Core writes an access log for every request
including requests rejected at the Consumer-Key check (e.g. invalid Consumer-Key) , these get no audit record
VCVPAuditLog holds only requests that pass the Consumer-Key check
Check Consumer-Key (DW Core central Consumer-Key) , caller channel = WALLET
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 07 (FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED)
Issuance stops here , card/document not added , sections 3 to 11 do not apply
Look up card/document schema in DocumentSchemas table
[SPEC] The credential schema must be created by the issuing agency
VCVP does not create a schema during issuance
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 07 (FailureReason = SCHEMA_NOT_FOUND , EngineCalls)
Issuance stops here , card/document not added , sections 3.2 to 11 do not apply
[SPEC] DW Core requests system to system with one central Consumer-Key for all agencies
The agency opts in per schema when creating it
Checked again when issuance is requested (section 5)
Check the agency allows requests from the wallet on this schema
only when caller channel = WALLET (DW central Consumer-Key)
[Wallet request not allowed by the agency]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 07 (FailureReason = WALLET_REQUEST_NOT_ALLOWED , EngineCalls)
Issuance stops here , card/document not added , sections 3.2 to 11 do not apply
Check issuer DID is listed and accreditation not expired | GET {trust registry URL}
trust validation result stored in TrustCheck.Result
trust registry reference stored in TrustCheck.RegistryReference
Written once with the audit record of this request , never updated
Keep trust validation result (for the audit record of VCVP Core 07)
Validate issuer is listed and accreditation not expired
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 07 (FailureReason = TRUST_FAILED , TrustCheck , EngineCalls)
Issuance stops here , card/document not added , sections 3.3 to 11 do not apply
[SPEC] Defined on the schema , not on the issuance request (engine name stored in DocumentSchemas field)
formats[] sets the format to SD_JWT_VC (stored in Formats[].Format)
allowSuspension must be set to true explicitly , otherwise the credential cannot be suspended (stored in Suspendable)
Revocation method is not stored in the schema , it comes from config that binds SD_JWT_VC to TOKENSTATUSLIST (stored in Formats[].RevocationMethod)
Each claim has a technicalKey separate from key , e.g. LicenseNumber -> license_number (stored in Claims[].Path , Claims[].Mappings[].TechnicalKey)
The name that appears in the credential is the technicalKey
Get schema details | GET /api/credential-schema/v2/{id} (VCVP Core 07) ({id} = CREDENTIAL_SCHEMA_ID from DocumentSchemas.EngineRefs[].RefDocumentSchemaId)
200 | schema details + Claims[] (ClaimId | Path | Name | Type | Required)
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 07 (TrustCheck , EngineCalls)
200 | schema details + Claims[] (ClaimId | Path | NameEn | NameLocal | Type | Required)
Keep IssuerTrust to send back to the app at the end of section 6
(DW reply to the add card/document request of section 1.2)
the app shows it in the preview in section 7.2
Map data to Claims[] based on schema details from VCVP Core 07
Set OrgCode of the issuing agency
(IssuerIdentityId and IssuerKey are not sent , VCVP Core selects them in section 5.1)
retentionPolicy = e.g. 10 years or regulatory requirement
Create tamper-evident audit record of the mapped claims (DW audit log)
logs of activities , exceptions , faults and other relevant events are produced , stored , protected and analysed
log protection : cryptographic hashing , append-only recording , read-only recording , public transparency files
users cannot delete or amend logs of their own activities
logs of PII processing record who accessed PII , when , whose PII and what was added , changed or deleted
logs can contain PII : access is controlled , used only as intended , deleted or de-identified by the retention schedule
Thai MDES notice on keeping computer traffic data B.E. 2564 clause 9 : storage keeps integrity and identifies who accessed it
administrators cannot modify stored data (e.g. centralized log server , data archiving , data hashing) | clause 12 : keep at least 90 days
No checked source requires signing the hash , so auditSignature is optional
Source limitation : ISO wording taken from secondary summaries (isms.online , checked 11 Oct 2026) , not from the ISO text itself
ISO standards are sold per copy , confirm the wording against the purchased ISO/IEC 27002:2022 and ISO/IEC 27701:2025 before citing in an audit
[DATA STORE] Store mapped claims + audit log in DW database (issuance request)
Check Consumer-Key (DW Core central Consumer-Key) , caller channel = WALLET
allowed to issue this VC type on behalf of this organisation
referenced data belongs to the caller's organisation
[SPEC] Claim name restrictions are enforced at schema creation , not at issuance
Name must not be "0" | must not contain / because it separates nested claim levels
Total key length must not exceed 255 characters
[SPEC] Engine key has no status or expiresAt (only id , createdDate , lastModified , organisationId
name , publicKey , keyType , storageType , isRemote , autogenerated)
Key status is kept in the VCVP Keys table : RESERVED / ACTIVE / DEPRECATED / REVOKED
Validate claims against schema | Validate key matches identity (Keys.IdentityId , if IssuerKey sent)
MessageCode , Message (HTTP status of the error)
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 08 (FailureReason = REQUEST_REJECTED)
[SPEC] Organisation , issuer key and DID must be prepared by the issuing agency in the setup phase
VCVP does not create them during issuance
If any of them is missing , VC is not issued and the card/document is not added
Look up agency organisation in Organizations table (OrgCode)
Select issuer DID from the schema
use IssuerIdentityId instead if the caller sent it
[SPEC] Issuer key status : RESERVED / ACTIVE / DEPRECATED / REVOKED
RESERVED = key placed in the DID at creation , not used for signing yet
Only one ACTIVE key per identity (unique index on IdentityId + Status = ACTIVE)
No ACTIVE key → handled in section 5.2 (switch to the next RESERVED key)
More than one ACTIVE key → configuration error , do not guess
VCVP Core always sends issuer and issuerKey to the engine , never relies on the engine default (first key in the DID)
Select issuer key = the ACTIVE key of that DID
use IssuerKey instead if the caller sent it
[Organisation / issuer DID not found , or more than one ACTIVE key]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 08
Issuance stops here , card/document not added , sections 5.2 to 11 do not apply
[Organisation and issuer DID found , at most one ACTIVE key]
Use ORG_ID , ISSUER_IDENTIFIER_ID , ISSUER_KEY_ID (ACTIVE key , if any)
5.2 Credential Lifecycle Policy and Issuer Key Check
[SPEC] Validity is defined on the schema (expiration) , not per credential
Revocation method comes from config bound to the format (SD_JWT_VC to TOKENSTATUSLIST)
revocation status method & credential lifecycle policy from schema / config
Get issuer key metadata from VCVP Keys table
[SPEC] DID can have multiple keys (verification methods)
All keys must be included when the DID is created (up to 5)
Engine has no identifier update API (only POST , GET , DELETE , list , /remote , resolve-trust-entries)
Keys cannot be added to an existing DID
Keys can be rotated without changing DID by switching issuerKey to a key already in the DID
[No ACTIVE key / key expired / near expiry / inactive]
[Next key reserved in the issuer DID is available]
Switch issuerKey to the next reserved key in the DID
[No reserved key left in the DID]
[SPEC] VCVP does not create a new key or DID during issuance
The existing DID cannot be updated , so new keys need a new DID
The issuing agency creates the new key and DID in the setup phase
and registers the new DID in the Trust Registry before use
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 08 (FailureReason = ISSUER_KEY_EXPIRED)
Issuance stops here , card/document not added , sections 6 to 11 do not apply
[SPEC] Keep old ISSUER_KEY_ID available for verifying previously issued credentials
Old key status = DEPRECATED, not revoked
Use new ISSUER_KEY_ID for new credential issuance only
Revoke old key only if compromised
Map VCVP ClaimId to engine claim id
[IMPORTANT] Nothing is signed at this step , no status list index is reserved and no token exists yet
State is CREATED and the credential field is empty
This request has no format , proofType , cnf or revocation method parameter
format and revocation method come from schema and config | cnf comes from the wallet proof at credential request
issuer takes the engine IdentifierId , not the did:web value
Credential expiry cannot be set per credential
[DATA STORE] Store document in Documents table
The offer contains credential_issuer , credential_configuration_ids (the vct URL)
transaction_code is not used , so the offer has no such field
Engine state changes from CREATED to PENDING after this call
Create offer link | POST /api/credential/v1/{CREDENTIAL_ID}/share (VCVP Core 08) (CREDENTIAL_ID from Documents table EngineRefs[].RefDocumentId)
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 08 (EngineCalls , Correlation.DocumentId)
Check Consumer-Key (DW Core central Consumer-Key) , caller channel = WALLET
[DATA STORE] Store offer in Documents table
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 09 (EngineCalls , Correlation.DocumentId)
[DATA STORE] Store offer in Documents table
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 08 (EngineCalls , Correlation.DocumentId)
The engine does not tell VCVP when an offer expires (credential webhook is sent only for ACCEPTED , SUSPENDED , REVOKED , REJECTED , ERROR)
The engine sets INTERACTION_EXPIRED only when its task INTERACTION_EXPIRATION_CHECK is run (POST /api/task/v1/run , scheduled by ops)
VCVP Core scheduled job : Documents with Status = PENDING and OfferExpiresAt passed , read the engine state first
engine PENDING or INTERACTION_EXPIRED : Status PENDING → OFFER_EXPIRED | engine OFFERED : keep Status = PENDING
A renewed offer link sets Status back to PENDING | credential_accepted later still sets Status to ACTIVE
A credential already in OFFERED (token exchanged) stays OFFERED , the holder can still get the credential with its access token
[DATA STORE] Store DocumentId + OfferUrl + ExpiresAt in DW database (issuance request)
